decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-04, read by Codex against the held Russian Synodal wording and 2 Kings 23:34 / 1 Chronicles 3:15-16; no person has reviewed this ruling
policy: Both Jehoiakim occurrences in the Synodal genealogy name the held king of Judah, Eliakim renamed Jehoiakim. This edition-local reading is not carried over statistical links into Greek editions that omit the name.
source: Essenthos, the Synodal Jehoiakim occurrences in Matthew 1:11, read by Codex on 2026-10-04

rulings.why: The Synodal reads Josiah begot Jehoiakim; Jehoiakim begot Jeconiah. 2 Kings 23:34 identifies Josiah's son Eliakim as the king renamed Jehoiakim, and 1 Chronicles 3:15-16 names Jehoiakim as Josiah's son and Jeconiah's father. This is the held king record, not the high priest Joiakim or the later Eliakim in Matthew 1:13.

The second Synodal occurrence is the same Jehoiakim just named as Josiah's son, now named as Jeconiah's father. The held 2 Kings 23:34 and 1 Chronicles 3:15-16 identify him with the king Eliakim renamed Jehoiakim.
